results.content: ## Event for the Koloniewedding 16.04. - 25.04.2026 Two-site exhibition "Naive vs. Primitive" 16.04 bis 25.04 Two-site exhibition “Naive vs. Primitive” Galerie BAS CS, in cooperation with the private gallery for contemporary art “Creative Place” (Moscow), presents the two-site exhibition “Naive vs. Objective: The exhibition offers artists who have not yet been able to participate in major exhibitions the opportunity to present their works. Alongside established artists, emerging artists at the beginning of their journey in naive and primitive art are also supported. His works are held in private collections in Russia as well as in England, the Netherlands, Latvia, Kazakhstan, Italy, Germany, Bahrain, Australia, and the USA, and also in the All-Russian Historical and Ethnographic Museum. “The work is dedicated to remembering and forgetting, appearing, and disappearing,” Karolina Żyniewicz notes about *Sign of the Times*, “resisting the passage of time, and confronting the imperfections of human memory.” During the exhibition opening hours (Thu – Sun, 2 – 6 pm) at Art Laboratory Berlin, Żyniewicz will perform her transcription from Thursdays to Saturdays, while being present Sundays to talk to visitors, and if they wish, lead further interviews that may contribute to future iterations of this research project.
